procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
3-month follow-up after the stillbirth of her twins in September.

Back at work full time since 12/8. Says the routine has helped; coworkers were kind. The holidays were hard, and the due date in early December was the worst week. Went to the perinatal loss group twice and plans to keep going monthly. Sleeping 6 to 7 hours most nights now, appetite back, enjoying time with her child. No self-harm thoughts. Not drinking.
PHQ-9 today 4 (was 8 in October).

Physically fully recovered, incision no longer sore.

Glucose tolerance test in November normal.

Meds: prenatal vitamin with iron (keeping it up on OB's advice for now). NKDA.

Exam: vitals as charted, BP normal. Weight 84 kg, down 2 since October. Brighter affect, engaged, smiles. Heart regular. Lungs clear. Incision well healed.

Assessment/plan:
1. Grief after perinatal loss, improving; PHQ-9 4. Continue support group. Reach out if anything slides, especially around anniversaries.
2. History of GDM: OGTT normal; A1c yearly from the physical.
3. Obesity, BMI about 33: she'd like to return to the walking routine in spring; we'll revisit at the physical.
Physical in April (Pap due).

documents.title: Refill Request - Prenatal Vitamin
documents.author: pharmacy
documents.body: Refill request received electronically: prenatal multivitamin with iron, take 1 tablet daily, quantity 90. Prior prescription has no refills remaining.
